1: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: “Main subah ke Rubb ki panah maangta hoon aur usi se hifazat chahta hoon.”
2: “Tamam makhluq ke nuqsan aur buraiyon se.”
3: “Aur main Allah ki panah maangta hoon un buraiyon se jo raat mein zahir hoti hain, yani nuqsan pohanchane wale jaanwar aur daaku.”
4: “Aur main us ki panah maangta hoon un jadoogarniyon ki buraai se jo gaanthon par phoonkti hain.”
5: “Aur main us ki panah maangta hoon hasad karne wale ki buraai se, jab woh apne hasad par amal kare.”
